# Thruster flame: a 6-sided cone 0.7 m long pointing down, a white core in a gold sheath, origin at its top. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Sheath --base-color 0.9255 0.6706 0.0667 --no-slot --emission 0.9255 0.6706 0.0667
material new Core --base-color 1.0000 1.0000 1.0000 --no-slot --emission 1.0000 1.0000 1.0000
add mesh cone --name Sheath --vertices 6 --radius1 0.06 --radius2 0.22 --depth 0.7 --location 0 0 -0.35
material assign Sheath
add mesh cone --name Core --vertices 6 --radius1 0.05 --radius2 0.13 --depth 0.42 --location 0 -0.1 -0.22
material assign Core
select all
shade flat
export flame.glb
